note: The 10 one-of-one Chogs. Each is a hero kit (for its holder) and a boss (in Siege). costume names a rig costume in atlas/rig.json; attack is a rig attack style; numbers live in the engine.

weapon.name: Fireball
weapon.effect: an arcing fireball that sets enemies alight

special.name: Flare Up
special.effect: a ring of fire bursts around the hero, burning everything near

ultimate.name: Wildfire
ultimate.effect: sets a long stretch of the road ablaze for 6 seconds

boss.effect: leaves burning footprints that set guards alight; immune to burning

weapon.name: Chain of Flames
weapon.effect: a fiery chain sweep that hits everything around the hero

special.name: Bone Shield
special.effect: spinning bones block every hit for 4 seconds

ultimate.name: Hell Ride
ultimate.effect: charges down the road in a blaze, burning all it passes

boss.effect: dashes ahead, scattering guards; revives once

weapon.name: Echo
weapon.effect: sound rings that pierce through a line of enemies

special.name: Existential Dread
special.effect: a wide cone of fear: enemies walk back

ultimate.name: The Scream
ultimate.effect: the whole screen warps: every enemy flees for 3 seconds

boss.effect: the screen warps and towers miss half their shots for 4 seconds

weapon.name: Brain Toss
weapon.effect: a squishy brain that slows what it hits

special.name: Shamble
special.effect: two zombie Chogs rise and fight for you

ultimate.name: Rise Again
ultimate.effect: the last five fallen enemies rise and fight on your side

boss.effect: raises fallen enemies to walk the road again

weapon.name: Tongue Lash
weapon.effect: a long tongue that pulls an enemy back

special.name: Feels Bad
special.effect: a sad aura: enemies near the hero slow to a crawl

ultimate.name: Rare Pepe
ultimate.effect: golden frogs rain down, each one stunning where it lands

boss.effect: leaps far down the road, shaking off slows

weapon.name: Ink Slash
weapon.effect: a brush-stroke slash with long reach

special.name: Speed Lines
special.effect: blinks to a spot, slashing everything on the way

ultimate.name: Final Panel
ultimate.effect: the screen turns into a manga panel: time stops, then one huge slash

boss.effect: time stops for your towers for 3 seconds

weapon.name: Holy Bolt
weapon.effect: a bolt of light that ignores armour

special.name: Halo
special.effect: heals the hero and every guard nearby

ultimate.name: Judgement
ultimate.effect: pillars of light strike all along the road

boss.effect: shields every enemy near it for 5 seconds

weapon.name: Spear
weapon.effect: a thrown spear that pierces a line of enemies

special.name: Shield Wall
special.effect: a wall of shields blocks the road for 4 seconds

ultimate.name: Phalanx
ultimate.effect: a volley of spears rains on the busiest stretch of road

boss.effect: raises its shield: blocks the next five hits

weapon.name: Gold Flick
weapon.effect: flicks gold coins that bounce between enemies

special.name: Golden Touch
special.effect: turns an enemy to gold: frozen for 3 seconds, then drops triple candy

ultimate.name: Midas Rain
ultimate.effect: a shower of gold: damage everywhere and candy for every hit

boss.effect: turns two towers to gold, silencing them for 5 seconds

weapon.name: Trident
weapon.effect: three bolts of hellfire in a spread

special.name: Imp Swarm
special.effect: three imps dive at the toughest enemies

ultimate.name: Deal With the Devil
ultimate.effect: double damage for 8 seconds; it costs one candy jar

boss.effect: steals three jars at once and calls a swarm of imps

greatPumpkin.name: The Great Pumpkin
phases: rolls down the road, flattening guards
at half health splits into three pumpkins
near the porch calls a final wave of trick-or-treaters
